mode: Actual local app without backend credentials; no API mocks
checks: Six real pages fit 320, 375, 390, 430, 768, 1024 and 1440px without horizontal page overflow.
Missing backend displays a connection error and no invented catalog, providers or purchase prices.

Five mobile customer tabs meet 44px height, header is clear, reduced-motion/landscape/200% text fit. Simulated visualViewport keyboard event hides and restores bottom navigation; physical iOS/Android keyboard is untested.
Actual APIs reject guest/cross-origin writes and malformed quote IDs; unavailable pricing fails closed. Customer, provider and admin routes require login. PWA manifest is standalone Turkish.
